h1: AI Video Ads Generator for Scroll-Stopping Ads
lead: This AI video ads generator builds the script, the presenter, the voice, and the cut. Begin with your product link. A short prompt works too. No creators, no shoots, and no editing software. You get a finished ad you can run.

definition.title: What This AI Video Ads Generator Does
paras: It produces a short video ad, with a script, an AI presenter, a voice, and the edit, from a product, a prompt, or a link. You do not film, and you do not open a separate editor.
Each ad is made to run in the frames paid placements expect, ready for TikTok, Meta, and a search ad. Export 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:3, or 3:4.

steps.t: Add a Link or a Photo
steps.d: Drop in a product link, or upload a photo. Add a short note about what you are advertising.
The tool writes the hook and the script, pairs a presenter with a voice, then renders the video.
Download the frame you need, or send the file to TikTok, Meta, or a search campaign. No watermark.

faq.q: Can every product in the catalog get its own ad?
faq.a: Yes. Make separate ads for many products in your catalog. Change the message or actor to test more versions without filming each item.

faq.q: What should I look for in an AI video ad tool?
faq.a: Choose a tool that makes scripts, actors, voices, and ad sizes from your product. AIVideosUGC also lets you make many versions for testing.

faq.q: How do these compare with ads filmed by creators?
faq.a: Results vary by product and audience. AI ads are useful for quick tests and many versions; a filmed creator suits campaigns needing a real person.

faq.q: How does a shop build the video ad?
faq.a: Upload a product photo or paste a link, then review the script and choose an actor. Download the finished ad in minutes.

faq.q: Which frame sizes and placements can the file use?
faq.a: Download square videos (1:1), portrait videos (9:16), or landscape videos (16:9) for TikTok, Meta, YouTube, and your store.

faq.q: What does a video ads generator produce?
faq.a: It makes a finished video ad from a product photo, link, or short description. Add an AI actor, voice, and script without filming.

faq.q: Are commercial rights included on a paid plan?
faq.a: Yes. Your watermark-free video is cleared for commercial use, including paid ads. You do not need a separate license for an AIVideosUGC AI actor.

faq.q: How much does an AI video ad cost?
faq.a: Video credits depend on length: 6 seconds costs 24, 10 costs 40, 15 costs 60, and 30 costs 120. Starter costs $24.50 for 200 credits.

faq.q: Will Meta or TikTok reject a generated clip?
faq.a: AI video ads can run on Meta and TikTok, subject to their current rules. Check whether your ad needs an AI label before posting.
